description:
ICICI Pru Multi Asset Fund is one of India’s largest multi asset allocation funds, managing over ₹80,000 crore in assets and accounting for nearly 42% of the category’s total AUM. 

But does its massive scale translate into strong performance and controlled risk?

Despite being equity-heavy, the fund has demonstrated solid downside protection, outperforming the Nifty 500 TRI in 8 out of 9 negative quarters since 2019. 

In this video, we analyse whether this performance is sustainable and whether the fund’s strategy truly justifies its popularity.

If you’re considering investing in ICICI Pru Multi Asset Fund, this detailed review will help you understand its returns, risk profile, asset allocation strategy, and overall positioning within the multi asset allocation category.

Watch till the end for our final verdict.
